messages:
karen: Heads-up — product asked for a simpler "net token cost" card in the dashboard. They want a single number per route that shows what actually hit billing (after cache/prefetch offsets).

ajay: +1 on the ask but important: we need to be explicit about how cache savings are allocated. A naive subtract will mislead for multi-model chains.

liz: Can we do a UI toggle: "Show raw tokens | Show net cost (amortized)"? Default to net cost but include an info tooltip linking to the allocation doc.

matt: From infra side, we only emit two signals today: `raw_tokens` and `cache_saved_tokens`. We don't have per-model lineage for prefetched keys unless router tags the chain.

karen: OK — what's the incremental work? If we add an explanation doc + toggle we can ship fast. If we need lineage we'll need API changes.

ajay: Idea: for MVP, compute net per-route by attributing cache savings proportionally to route token footprint in the same session window. Not perfect but deterministic.

liz: That sounds OK as a temporary model. UX needs a clear label like "amortized cache credit (session-weighted)" and a hover explaining the heuristic.

matt: Implementation notes: we can add a boolean param to the econ-telemetry pipeline `amortize_cache=true` that triggers a post-aggregation step. Rough pseudo:
```sql
-- session-level attribution (pseudo)
SELECT route, SUM(raw_tokens) as r_tokens, SUM(cache_saved) as c_tokens,
  r_tokens - (c_tokens * r_tokens / SUM(r_tokens) OVER (session_id)) as net_estimated
FROM invocation_telemetry
WHERE ts >= :start AND ts < :end
GROUP BY session_id, route
```

matt: That SQL would run in our batch job, then we can surface both columns in the dashboard.

karen: Good. Any concerns about cost or perf for running that extra step?

ajay: Batch compute is fine. Real-time UI preview is trickier. We can return cached snapshot; realtime can show an estimated number with "last snapshot at X".

liz: UX question: where should the toggle live? Per-route header or global dashboard control? I vote per-route so PMs can compare routes side-by-side.

matt: Per-route toggle requires per-route metadata in the query. Should be easy. We'll need to add a small API field to the dashboard backend: `display_mode: raw|net_amortized`.

ops-bot: deploybot: new feature branch created: feat/econ/amortize-cache-1755. CI kicked off. :rocket:

karen: Nice. Action items: matt -> prototype SQL and add pipeline flag, liz -> mockups for per-route toggle + tooltip, ajay -> write short spec of heuristics + limitations, I'll synthesize copy for the tooltip and product note.

ajay: One more callout: make sure we persist the snapshot used for billing explainability. If we show a number in the UI, customers will ask why it changed. Persist the snapshot id + heuristic version.

matt: agree — we'll add `econ_snapshot_id` and `heuristic_version` to the row emitted to the metrics DB.

karen: Great. Target: ship MVP snapshot + UI toggle to staging by next Wed. If blockers, ping here.

liz: I'll post mocks by EOD tomorrow.

matt: I'll drop the pipeline PR link when CI passes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4021

ajay: Optional future: router could attach `chain_context` to invocations (lightweight lineage token counts). That would let us do per-model precise crediting later.

karen: Add that to the backlog as a spike. For now we'll go with amortized session heuristic.

ops-bot: calendar: reminder — econ sync Friday 10am to review mocks and pipeline PR.

karen: Thanks all. We'll iterate after the staging run. :thumbsup:
